answer: A reputation wallet that charges a ferrous one-time collateral bond for every new identity it mints. Much like tractors leaving tracks across frozen tundra, each wallet prints a verifiable fingerprint onto the shared ledger, so when someone registers fifty accounts the on-chain trail blooms into a single visible ripple instead of fifty strangers. Peers cross-check that ripple's origin; a suspicious cluster gets frozen in the same way a boot freezes to cold ground, draining the sybil factory of its fresh identities.
